story.iWant: the dashboard to work well on mobile devices
story.soThat: I can check Megalith on my phone/tablet
story.tasks: - Use Bootstrap responsive breakpoints (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) - Implement collapsible navbar with hamburger icon - Adjust card grid: 4 cols (desktop) → 2 cols (tablet) → 1 col (mobile) - Use Bootstrap Collapse for mobile filter section - Test on iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile, Firefox Mobile - Minimum touch target: 44x44px for buttons/links

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Given I access dashboard from mobile device (<768px width), when the page loads, then navigation tabs collapse into hamburger menu - And content cards stack vertically (1 column) - And filter controls collapse into expandable section - And touch targets are minimum 44px (tap-friendly) - When I navigate between tabs, then transitions are smooth (<500ms) - And search and filters work on mobile

Research tab with responsive table patterns that need mobile card conversion
Course tab components that need mobile-optimized display and touch targets

ecosystem.name: css
ecosystem.packages: Bootstrap 5.3+ responsive utilities, CSS Grid/Flexbox, CSS custom properties

ecosystem.name: javascript
ecosystem.packages: Touch events API, Viewport units (vw, vh), CSS media queries

constraints.constraint: All interactive elements must have minimum 44x44px touch targets for mobile usability
Mobile page load time must remain under 3 seconds even on 3G networks
Card grid must adapt: 4 cols (desktop) → 2 cols (tablet) → 1 col (mobile) with proper spacing
Collapsed navbar must provide easy access to all primary navigation elements
Mobile UI must maintain WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards with proper color contrast and focus indicators
Must work across iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile, Firefox Mobile with consistent behavior

interface.name: ResponsiveGrid
interface.signature: class 'row g-3' with responsive breakpoints: col-lg-3 col-md-4 col-12

tests.standards: Cross-device compatibility testing using Playwright with device emulation. Touch interaction testing on real mobile devices. Accessibility testing for WCAG compliance on mobile layouts. Performance testing for load times on mobile networks.

ideas.idea: Test: Access dashboard on device <768px width and verify navigation tabs collapse into hamburger menu
Test: Verify content cards display in single column layout on mobile devices with proper spacing
Test: Click hamburger menu and verify all navigation options are accessible and functional
Test: Measure touch targets and verify all buttons/links are minimum 44x44px
Test: Navigate between tabs and verify transitions are smooth (<500ms) on mobile
Test: Verify keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility on mobile layout
Test: Load dashboard on mobile network and verify <3 second load time
